strings.editor.portal.pairNeedsTwo: A pair needs two different dimensions: create the second one first.

strings.editor.world.analyticsHint: Empty while the property does not exist: with no ID no script is loaded at all.
strings.editor.world.arrival: The destination declares the arrival of this world.

strings.editor.world.gapLine: {from} → {to}: the destination does not declare the arrival
